Cors._comment: Origins allowed to call this API from a browser. Empty means fail-closed (no browser client may call it). The list mirrors the agent's WebApi:AllowedCorsOrigins so Studio can reach both services on a default install. Found 2026-10-07: this section was absent, so the shipped default denied every origin and Studio's Workflow view failed with a CORS error on every request — the feature was unreachable out of the box. Remove these entries for a hardened deployment that only accepts non-browser callers.
